sentences.en: The authorities are striving in vain to stabilize the currency.
sentences.zh: 当局徒劳地试图稳定货币。

sentences.en: The presence of the Moon stabilized the Earth’s spin axis.
sentences.zh: 月球的存在稳定了地球的自转轴。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to stabilize and reinforce its home front.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要稳固国内局势并加强内部支持。

senses.zh: 使…坚固；使…安定；装稳定器（等于stablize）
